result.title: APEC, ASEAN and the Art of Alignment
result.description:
Given the Asia-Pacific region's outsized role in driving global growth, multistakeholder cooperation to enhance regional integration is critical to improving quality of life for hundreds of millions of people. APEC and ASEAN share common goals and sufficient institutional architecture to amplify each other's distinct offerings.

How can both regional architectures increase strategic coordination to strengthen their joint contribution to global stability and prosperity?

result.title: Why Biomanufacturing Is a Big Deal
result.description:
Biosolutions refer to radically modernized biological and chemical processes: leveraging AI and scientific innovation to make concrete grow, turn CO2 emissions into fertiliser, enhance food security and solve critical supply chain problems. 

The potential is vast. But what will it take for biomanufacturing to achieve cost-competitive, global scale?

result.title: More Content, Less Learning
result.description:
Digital tools and platforms have made learning more accessible than at any point in history, yet foundational literacy and numeracy are falling in many economies. While we have improved user experiences and abundant content, the ability to learn is not catching up.

Why is unprecedented access to knowledge not producing better outcomes and how can it be used to improve how we learn?

result.title: Ageing as an Asset
result.description:
China is entering a new demographic era, with one of the world’s fastest-ageing populations reshaping its economic and social landscape. At the same time, advances in genetics, regenerative medicine and preventive health are deepening the understanding of ageing and healthy living. 

As science and policy evolve, what will it take to realize the full potential of longevity?
